protocol.cohort: complete source-report validation cohort in saved selected-row order
protocol.online_boundary: serial sampling + gather + transfer + encoders + GNN + readout
protocol.seed_scheme: seed + batch-size position * 1000000 + batch_index * repeats + repeat
protocol.stage_timing: separate synchronized replay; not added to online latency
protocol.warmup_seed: reset torch RNG to the query-batch sampling seed before warmups

excluded_from_online_timing: correctness audits, RNG seeding, reporting and telemetry setup

host_memory.scope: process lifetime, including imports and one-time graph preparation

notes: All execution modes use the same frozen weights and paired sampled occurrences.
Graph inputs retain the source checkpoint's conditional exported-snapshot semantics.
The source activity baseline scored better; this is an execution experiment.
Batch-size comparisons may use different sampler draws across sizes.
Stage replays are separate measurements; never add their medians to online latency.
Intervals cover measured query batches, not session or training-seed variability.
online_boundary: serial sampling + gather + transfer + encoders + GNN + readout

limitations: Schema/footer inspection cannot establish that exported values were available at the record timestamp.
Only constants and relative record time are approved; every candidate raw attribute remains excluded.
Historical foreign-key updates, entity merges, record deletions, and export survivorship have not been reconstructed.
Record-time visibility and per-query occurrence ownership must still pass the actual sampled-batch audit.
No preprocessing is fitted here. Any future learned preprocessing must be fitted on training-period data only.
This policy does not establish training readiness or predictive quality.

reference.estimand: 100 * (1 - sum(blocks online ms) / sum(baseline online ms))
